chapter_title: Concerning the Wheel and the Conduits
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

**¶1:** How does the cycle of Providence revolve through the channels of influx, which extend from interior heavenly states down into exterior natural states, without severing them? And why do the channels of influx not become entangled with the revolving progression of states as it turns and drives [GAP-1] through the whole of the created spiritual world?

**¶2:** The reason the channels of influx are not severed — for indeed they cannot be severed — is that they are of spiritual substance. The channels of influx are like truths through which systems of doctrine pass. One finds that the leading intellectual faculty, positioned at the fore of a doctrinal system, penetrates into truths, distinguishing them to one side and the other. And when that faculty parts the truths, and the doctrinal system opens its way through truth by means of its penetrating understanding, immediately and without delay the truths flow together and reunite behind the doctrinal system; and the passage of doctrine leaves no disruption discernible in the body of truth itself.

**¶3:** In the same way, when a thought rises into the rational atmosphere of the mind, its path cannot be traced in that atmosphere. And so it is with the human will and understanding, moving within the Divine love and wisdom that operates through the channels of influx. They also are not entangled in those channels, nor shall their passage through the rational sphere be found to leave any mark.

**¶4:** So it is likewise with the cycle of Providence. It revolves through the channels of influx and through the rational atmosphere of the mind. The cycle of Providence does not sever the channels of influx, nor are the channels of influx themselves entangled in its revolution.

---

*Note on the whole passage:* The teaching is that Divine influx — flowing continuously from interior states to exterior states — is of such spiritual nature that no cyclical operation, no progressive change of state, no passage of doctrine or thought through it, can interrupt or deform it. It restores itself perfectly, as truths restore their unity after being distinguished by understanding. The spiritual substance of influx is self-healing; Providence moves through it without trace or harm.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: How does the wheel circle over the conduits, which extend from the heavens to the earths, and it not cut them? Or why shall the conduits not get entangled in with the wheel as it circles and drives [onward through the u]niverse?

The reason that the conduits shall not be cut, for they are not cut, is because they are spiritual. Thus the conduits are like the waters through which ships sail. You shall find the prow that is in position in the front part of the ship divides the waters, casting them back and forth. So, when it parts the waters and that ship opens up the water with its cleaving prow, immediately and without delay the waters mingle with each other again behind the ship; and the path of the ship shall not be discernible in the midst of the waters.

Just as when a bird flies up in the air, for its path is not visible in the air, and in the way of mankind, in the sun within the conduits. They also shall not be tangled up in them, and neither shall you find their path through the air known.
This is also the case with the wheel. It turns through the conduits and the air. The wheel shall not cut the conduits, nor are the conduits themselves entangled in the wheel.

fills.explanation: The wheel "circles and drives onward through the universe" — the adverb "onward" captures the continuous forward progression of Providence through the created world, matching the spiritual reading's emphasis on uninterrupted driving motion through the whole of creation.
